candidates.name: python-vacasa-connect-sdk
candidates.what_it_holds: Official-looking Python SDK published under the Vacasa GitHub org for the connect.vacasa.com API (units/properties, reviews, generic GET endpoints). Confirmed via README: requires OIDC client-id/secret/scope credentials tied to a Vacasa owner/partner account — this is private property-management data, not a public dataset. 1 star, updated 2026-07-22 (actively maintained).
candidates.why_useful: Confirms Vacasa's API surface (units, reviews) exists and is documented, useful if the team ever gets partner/owner access, but as-is it cannot be pulled without credentials, so it does not satisfy the 'public source' cataloguing bar.
candidates.time_coverage: n/a — live API, no historical archive implied

candidates.name: vacasa-ha
candidates.what_it_holds: Home Assistant custom integration exposing a Vacasa owner's own booking calendar and sensors (occupied/vacant, upcoming bookings) inside a smart-home dashboard. Requires the user's own Vacasa owner login; single-property scope by design, not a market-wide dataset. Updated 2026-07-08.
candidates.why_useful: Shows Vacasa exposes a booking-calendar API per property, but scope is one owner's one property at a time and needs credentials — not usable as a market-level dataset.

notes: This theme is close to a dead end on GitHub. Extensive gh search across Hostelworld, Vacasa, Sonder, Hipcamp, Outdoorsy, RVshare, Inspirato, Marriott Homes & Villas, onefinestay, Plum Guide, Blueground, and Flatio surfaced essentially zero real datasets. The overwhelming majority of hits (Hostelworld: ~40 results; Hipcamp: ~30 results) are coding-bootcamp/portfolio full-stack CLONES of the consumer-facing websites (React/Rails/Redux apps named 'Campster', 'AirCamp', 'Camp-Away', 'Hippocampus', 'Dripcamp', etc.) with zero real market data, or are the companies' own internal engineering repos (ESLint/stylelint shareable configs, a voice-assistant integration) that expose no data. Sonder, Outdoorsy, RVshare, Inspirato, Marriott Homes & Villas, onefinestay, Plum Guide, Blueground, and Flatio each returned ZERO results across every query tried (both combined-OR queries, which gh search treats as literal AND of tokens rather than boolean OR, and single-term queries) — no GitHub repos reference these brands at all in a data/API context, likely because most (Sonder, Inspirato) are small-cap/niche public or private companies with no open developer ecosystem, and RVshare/Outdoorsy are marketplaces without public APIs anyone has wrapped. The only two live threads worth naming are (1) unofficial/community Hostelworld scrapers (low confidence — one had a dead README link, suggesting possible repo rename or deletion) and (2) Vacasa's OWN official partner SDK and a Home-Assistant owner integration, both of which are real but require private owner/partner credentials, so they fail the 'public source' bar in CONTEXT.md rule bullet 3. Recommend: do not re-run this exact theme; if another scout wants to push further, try Sonder's SEC filings/8-K parser angle (sonder is a public company, ticker SOND, so a generic 'SEC EDGAR 10-Q parser' or 'company-facts XBRL' scout searching by CIK rather than brand name might surface Sonder KPI extraction tools that a brand-name search cannot find) and try searching for 'STR marketplace API wrapper' or 'vacation rental API client' generically rather than by individual competitor brand, since none of these platforms have enough hobbyist mindshare to produce named repos. Google Trends / consensus-history related to these tickers is out of scope for this theme (covered by other scouts).
